feature_contract.goal: Integrate safe native DirectGPU OpenXR race stereo, world-locked menu/vehicle stereo and mono theater projections against runtime-provided swapchain image indices, preserving original game input and last released projection when image metadata is incomplete.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both left and right GPU RTVs are checked against the waited OpenXR image index before rendering native game stereo.
World-locked menu and vehicle render use two-eye validation; theater uses one-eye validation without indexing stale resource arrays.
Invalid image index, array size or missing right eye rejects before GPU draw and releases the waited invalid image; original game path remains intact.
New compiled positive/negative OpenXR smoke and all five GitHub actions run for one exact material SHA with HMD still untested.

development_strategy.blocking_evidence: Production vrhost main.cpp and main_r23.cpp unconditionally indexed swapchain.rtvs[image] after xrAcquireSwapchainImage in native game-eye, world-locked menu and theater rendering, even if runtime-supplied index is out of range or RTV array is incomplete.
integration_path: Game-created D3D9 Draw and DrawIndexed mirrored as native full-resolution D3D11 image and independent eye sources
OpenXR shared source submitted through host source selection and validated runtime swapchain index/1-or-2-eye RTV allocation
DirectGPU race projection, stereo menu/vehicle and mono theater route to valid OpenXR layer; original D3D9 Present, controls and cached previous projection survive failure
batch_components: Real host C++ OpenXR acquisition and RTV validation
Production R23 menu, theater and native left/right GPU eye draw integration
Compiled host C++ native direct eye smoke positive and negative cases

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Host smoke admits in-range two-eye race/menu and single-eye theater RTV indices.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Host smoke rejects stale/out-of-range OpenXR indices, mono array on stereo projection, missing second eye, and truncated RTV arrays.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Native game full-frame DirectGPU OpenXR pair -> waited and bounded swapchain acquisition -> stereo R23 projection or mono theater -> existing HMD cache/DX9Ex input fallback.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Native OpenXR source route and automated build only; real Quest3/VDXR stereo visuals and performance untested.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Existing NativeDrawPathActive opt-in remains disabled by default; D3D9 Draw, Present, gamepad, FFB, SkyGlow, DX9Ex fallback unchanged; DXVK frozen.
